cases.purpose: Readonly key binding fails after terminal restoration; a subsequent input succeeds and fullscreen stop restores modes.
cases.oracle: Independent finite Kitty direct RGB/RGBA and POSIX shared-memory consumer follows the official graphics protocol; query success/rejection, m continuation, q quiet replies, complete-image placement, C cursor policy and typed geometry are decoded from actual PTY bytes. Frame1 a=f replacement and a=c/N=2 composition are explicitly a Kilix profile, not general Kitty conformance. Native guarded Python PTY query/reply and owned shm read/unlink, literal positive/negative consumer controls, independently decoded PNG/PPM assets, Python Unicode and separate canvas math validate expectations in setup. No GNU GPU API, GLES, shader, DMABUF or physical rendering equivalence is claimed.
cases.comparison: Exact result.json pixels/cursor/geometry/input-variable bytes and canvas.rgba versus independently authored fixture data rechecked by guest reference math. Full untouched PTY wire, per-packet payloads and intermediate composition pixels, actual helper replies/suppression, owned shm inode/data/unlink observations, geometry, syscall readiness, modes before/during/after input, elapsed intervals and original shell output stay in diagnostics. No sent key or FAIL implies an unexecuted later phase.
